title: SMTO-EXE-0274 — The computer running the Gateway can't make this kind of chart
summary: SMTO's chart tools on the selected computer are missing some of the software they need, so the chart format you asked for can't be made there right now. Other chart types may still work.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0274 — The computer running the Gateway can't make this kind of chart

html:
SMTO-EXE-0274 — The computer running the Gateway can't make this kind of chart

GUID: 2b70a8e1-09e2-5515-94a4-dd440dc8eac5
Slug: gateway-dependency-missing
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: gateway

What happened

  • SMTO's chart tools on the selected computer are missing some of the software they need, so the chart format you asked for can't be made there right now. Other chart types may still work.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. On the computer running the Gateway, run the SMTO installer again from the SMTO folder (for example ./install.sh), using the same account the Gateway runs as. The installer puts back the missing chart software and the browser SMTO uses to save charts as pictures.
  2. When no tasks are running on that Gateway, restart the Gateway program on that computer. The Gateway only checks its chart software when it starts, so it won't notice the repair until it restarts.
  3. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways, select Check connection for that Gateway, then select Refresh targets in the conversation's Target menu. This makes SMTO pick up the Gateway's repaired chart abilities.
  4. Start a new task and ask for the chart again. Until the repair is done, you can ask for a PNG chart made with Matplotlib or an interactive HTML chart instead. Older tasks keep the Gateway abilities they started with, and those other formats need less software.

What success looks like

  • Expanding the Gateway in Settings › Setup › Gateways shows chart abilities such as visualization_plotly_png under Capabilities, and the new task produces the chart.

If it still fails

  • Send the installer's output and the copied error details to the person who installed SMTO. Repair the existing installation; don't delete the Gateway, its pairing, its settings or task files to start over.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Visualization readiness on the selected Gateway reported gateway_dependency_missing: a plotting package (numpy, pandas, matplotlib, plotly or kaleido) is missing or failed installer verification, no executable Chromium browser was found for Plotly PNG export, or the recorded export check failed.

What this means

  • Visualization readiness cannot confirm all required local packages, an executable Chromium browser or successful recorded export checks; it reports a dependency problem with available capability flags. Readiness describes the selected Gateway and does not grant execution permission. Settle active work before an operator restart, then refresh metadata for the intended new task.

Why this can happen

  • Visualization readiness cannot confirm all required local packages, an executable Chromium browser or successful recorded export checks; it reports a dependency problem with available capability flags.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect missing_packages, browser_detected and the specific output capability instead of assuming every chart format is unavailable.

How to fix it

  • From the matching checkout on the Gateway host, rerun ./install.sh (server plus local Gateway) or the Gateway-only installer (./src/gateway_agent/install.sh on Linux, ./src/gateway_macos/install.sh on macOS, .\src\gateway_windows\install.ps1 on Windows) as the Gateway's own OS account. After the installer's dependency audit passes and active jobs are settled, restart the Gateway (readiness is cached per process), confirm the expected visualization_* capability tags under Settings › Setup › Gateways, and refresh targets before starting a new task; existing tasks keep their captured capability snapshot.
  • Reinstall or repair the affected Gateway by rerunning its supported installer on that Gateway host. After installation succeeds and active work is settled, restart the Gateway and refresh its metadata.
  • From the matching repository checkout, run ./install.sh for the server and local Gateway, or use the Gateway-only installer: ./src/gateway_agent/install.sh on Linux, ./src/gateway_macos/install.sh on macOS, or .\src\gateway_windows\install.ps1 on Windows. Run it as the account used by the Gateway so its environment and browser caches are repaired.
  • After active jobs and uncertain operations are reconciled, restart the affected Gateway. Restart the server too if the shared installer updated it. Refresh Gateway metadata before starting a new task.
  • Require the installer dependency audit and local functional checks to pass, then verify the selected Gateway advertises the required capability. Start a new task after refreshing metadata; existing tasks retain their captured capability snapshot.

Retry and execution caution

  • Require the installer dependency audit and local functional checks to pass, then verify the selected Gateway advertises the required capability. Start a new task after refreshing metadata; existing tasks retain their captured capability snapshot. Inspect prior execution receipts before repeating work.

How to verify the fix

  • The requested output format passes refreshed readiness and its supported rendering check after installation repair.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.
  • Repair the installation in place; do not delete Gateway pairing, credentials, settings, browser profiles or task artifacts.
  • Granting a Skill permission does not install its dependencies.

Technical notes

  • Readiness describes the selected Gateway and does not grant execution permission. Settle active work before an operator restart, then refresh metadata for the intended new task.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
